description: "Michael Liedtke reports on the trials involving Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani, providing coverage of the events."

"Elizabeth Holmes was the founder and former CEO of Theranos, facing charges related to the company's fraudulent activities."
"The jury deliberations resulted in a guilty verdict for Ramesh 'Sunny' Balwani on all 12 charges he faced."
"The jury deliberations resulted in a guilty verdict for Elizabeth Holmes on two counts of wire fraud and two counts of conspiracy to commit fraud."
